purpose: Source-backed company/line-level stock head fallback rules for snareReferenceDrums stock readiness.
ruleRequirements: Only stock batter/reso heads may use this fallback.
No shell, hoop, throw-off, lug, snare wire, bearing edge, or production status fields may be inferred by this rule set.
Each rule must have a source URL and source confidence.
Each rule must state whether it is exact model stock data, company-level default, distributor/OEM relationship, or conservative generic placeholder.
Rules with status=DRAFT are not applyable.

rules.notes: SONOR Kompressor group contains 17 candidates across aluminum, beech, brass, and steel. The SONOR Kompressor source confirms the series/model family, but current evidence does not confirm exact stock batter and reso/snare-side head models. Keep DRAFT until exact stock batter head and exact stock reso/snare-side head are source-confirmed. Split by shell material only if stock heads vary across aluminum, beech, brass, and steel variants.
